```{r}
#libraries
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

#Path 
source_path = "G:/My Drive/Bakulski Lab/Projects/CTD-Dementia/data/"

#Data
#Parent list of chemical names with MeshID, and CTD Chemical ID sean based categorization after
chem_names <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "ctd_31_meshparentsplit_4.29.25.xlsx"))

#Analytic sample 
chem <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "CTD_chem_GE50_genes_10.30.25.xlsx"))
```

# Create list of names with ChemicalID for analytic sample (n=1008)

```{r}
  
#Aggregate to get single occurance of chemical name
agg_tbl <- chem %>% group_by(chemical_name) %>% 
  summarise(total_count=n(),
            .groups = 'drop')

df<- left_join(agg_tbl, chem_names, by = "chemical_name")

```

```{r}
#save
saveRDS(catsubset4, paste0(source_path, "chem_with_cats_1008_11.10.25.rds"))
```

# Get predefined chemical classifications

## read each tab as its own data frame

```{r}

#2. get chemical classifications

vit <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "Categorization_plan_090325.xlsx"), sheet = 2) %>%
  select(chemical_name, ChemicalID) %>%
  mutate(category = "Vitamins and Dietary Components") %>%
  arrange(desc(category))

  select(chemical_name, ChemicalID) %>%
  mutate(category = "Metals and Metal Compounds") %>%
```

# Assign categories

```{r}
#check names
names(df)

#Subset to needed columns only 
df1 <- df %>% select(chemical_name, gene_count, total_count, ChemicalID)


#Apply categories 
t1<-df1 %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(ChemicalID %in% vit$ChemicalID ~ "Vitamins and Dietary Components", 
                              ChemicalID %in% metal$ChemicalID ~ "Metals and Metal Compounds", 
                              ChemicalID %in% fluro$ChemicalID ~ "Fluorocarbons",
                              ChemicalID %in% phthalic$ChemicalID ~ "Phthalic Acids and Plasticizers", 
                              ChemicalID %in% pesticides$ChemicalID ~ "Pesticides, Pesticide Synergists and Cholinesterase Inhibitors", 
                              ChemicalID %in% VOCs$ChemicalID ~ "Volatile Organic Compounds",
                              ChemicalID %in% polychl$ChemicalID ~ "Polychlorinated Biphenyls and Flame Retardants",
                              ChemicalID %in% PAH$ChemicalID ~ "Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons",
                              ChemicalID %in% environmental.pol$ChemicalID ~ "Environmental Pollutants and Complex Mixtures",
                              ChemicalID %in% pytoestrog$ChemicalID ~ "Pytoestrogens, Alkaloids, and Terpenes",
                              ChemicalID %in% personal.care$ChemicalID ~ "Personal Care, Consumer Products, Therapeutic Agents, Pharmacologic Actions and Specialty Use Chemicals", #
                              ChemicalID %in% biological.fac$ChemicalID ~ "Biological Factors", #
                              ChemicalID %in% elements$ChemicalID ~ "Elements and Minerals",
                              ChemicalID %in% flourine$ChemicalID ~ "Flourine, Chlorine or Bromine compounds", #
                              ChemicalID %in% sulfur$ChemicalID ~ "Sulfur compounds",
                              ChemicalID %in% other.nitrogen.comps$ChemicalID ~ "Other Nitrogen-Containing Compounds (Amides, Amidines, Amines, Azo, Hydrazines, Isocyanates, Triazines, Nitriles, Nitro and Nitroso Compounds)", #
                              ChemicalID %in% carboxylic$ChemicalID ~ "Carboxylic acids", #
                              ChemicalID %in% hydrocarbons$ChemicalID ~ "Hydrocarbons (Chlorinated, Acyclic, Aromatic, Halogenated, Cyclic, Other)", #
                              ChemicalID %in% organophosphorus$ChemicalID ~ "Organophosphorus compounds", #
                              ChemicalID %in% other.org.comps$ChemicalID ~ "Other Organic Chemicals (Ethers, Alcohols, Aldehydes, Ketones, Lactones, Quinones, Carbohydrates, Lipids, Organosilicon", #
                              ChemicalID %in% heterocyclic.comps$ChemicalID ~ "Heterocyclic Compounds", #
                              ChemicalID %in% hormones$ChemicalID ~ "Hormones, Hormone Substitutes, Steroids and Hormone Antagonists", #
                              ChemicalID %in% nucleic.acids$ChemicalID ~ "Nucleic Acids, Nucleotides, Nucleosides, Amino Acids, Peptides, and Proteins", #
                              ChemicalID %in% other$ChemicalID ~ "Other (Selenium Compounds, Onium Compounds, Gases, Free Radicals, Coordination Complexes, Noxae, Boron Compounds)"))

#Check 
table(t1$category, useNA = "always")


#assign 10 chems with NA category to "other"
t1$category[is.na(t1$category)] <- "other"

#restrict to columns needed 
#t1<- t1 %>% select(1,20,13:16, 19)

#save
write.xlsx(t1, paste0(source_path, "CTD_all_analytic_categories_1364_10.28.25.xlsx"))

```
